purpose: donation of a stone water conduit (śilādroṇī) for the benefit of all living beings (sattvānāṃ hitahetave)
notes: The inscription records the donation of a stone water reservoir/conduit by a Buddhist nun (bhikṣuṇī). Her personal name is damaged and unrecoverable from the fragmentary text (DV: 'ḥ paun - - mbhikṣuṇī su--kyā'; R: 'paunapānyā bhikṣuṇī'). No date is preserved.
